note: Every expected value below was derived by hand (derivation field), NOT by running the code under test.

baseline_median_mad.reporting_note: scale is REPORTED rounded to 3 decimals (4.448); scores use the unrounded 4.4478

test_windows.derivation: 15.5656/4.4478: 4.4478*3.4996 = 15.56552, rest 0.00008/4.4478 = 0.000018 → z = 3.499618 < 3.5, but it is rounded to 3 decimals (3.5) BEFORE the comparison → flag. The window mean is first rounded to 0.001 bpm (81.066 → z = 15.566/4.4478 = 3.49971) and z is rounded to 0.001 before the comparison → flag. Effective threshold ≈ 3.4995 (documented discretisation, FORMULA_AUDIT F-7)

windows_half_open.derivation: window k = [from + 300k, from + 300(k+1)); a sample at from+300 s belongs to window 1, not 0; samples before from or at/after to belong to no window (never clamped into an edge window)

hrs_packets.derivation: flags 0x16 = RR present (0x10) + contact supported (0x04) + contact detected (0x02); HR uint8 0x48 = 72; RR raw little-endian 00 04 = 0x0400 = 1024 → 1000 ms
flags 0x14: RR flag set but no RR bytes → corrupt
flags 0x01 = uint16 HR but only 1 byte → truncated
flags 0x04 contact supported, NOT detected; HR 72; one trailing byte → corrupt
contact supported, not detected → contact false

missing_values.derivation: 30 valid + 5 missing → valid fraction 30/35 = 0.857 ≥ 0.8 → usable, mean of VALID = 60; 30 valid + 10 missing → 30/40 = 0.75 < 0.8 → unusable (low_valid_fraction): missing data lowers coverage, never the value
